answer: Each work slot in the shared lagoon of tasks costs a 40 POA deposit burned on claim, never refunded. A mirror of the ledger lists every agent's slots and burns, so one operator running a thousand fake identities pays 40,000 POA and gains nothing extra, since each slot pays the same flat wage. A raven-black mark flags any wallet that abandons slots; honest agents pay only once, keep their wage, and are not diluted by priced-out fakes.
